dedupe_keys.name: re emission reservoir greenhouse gas model

description: Re-Emission is a Python model and command-line tool maintained by Tom Janus and collaborators for estimating greenhouse-gas emissions from reservoirs. It calculates carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide emission profiles and lifecycle totals for single reservoirs or batches. Users supply reservoir and upstream catchment properties in JSON or Python, choose methods and parameters in YAML, and receive tabular and mapped outputs. Geographic coverage is user-defined reservoir sites; time coverage follows the selected lifecycle profile. GPL-3.0 source and usage documentation are public. A limitation is that emission estimates depend on catchment delineation and biogeochemical assumptions; its linked Myanmar map is labelled preliminary and should not be treated as validation of every reservoir. The model supports hydropower and dam climate-impact scenario analysis. Two closed DataCite candidates concern Myanmar output data, not this reusable general model, so they are not duplicate identities. The catalogue's model-lisflood-fp addresses flooding, not reservoir emissions. No catchment dataset or package was downloaded.
name: Re-Emission reservoir greenhouse-gas model
